idle.name: no-target
idle.note: the control call names no session

idle.name: bad-id
idle.note: the target is not a session id

idle.name: turn-starting-admitted
idle.note: a turn start of the target is being admitted

idle.name: turn-starting-fenced
idle.note: another idle delete of the target is running

startWhileFenced.message: Session "sess_idle_4" closed: session is being deleted

idle.name: unguarded
idle.note: the caller gives no isHostedBusy guard

idle.name: current
idle.note: the target is the session the runtime has current

idle.name: busy-lock-not-archived
idle.note: a turn holds the target's ask lock; the target is not archived

idle.name: busy-lock-archived
idle.note: a turn holds the target's ask lock; the target is archived

idle.name: not-archived
idle.note: the target is not archived

idle.name: unknown-session
idle.note: no session of that id exists: it has no archive mark

idle.name: favorite
idle.note: the target is archived and a favorite

idle.name: turn-waiting
idle.note: a turn reaches the ask lock while the archive flag is read

idle.name: busy-unsettled
idle.note: a turn of the target is not yet durable

idle.name: in-flight-not-archived
idle.note: a turn of the target is in flight and holds no ask lock; the target is not archived

idle.name: in-flight-archived
idle.note: a turn of the target is in flight and holds no ask lock; the target is archived

idle.name: queued-pending
idle.note: input waits in the target's pending queue

idle.name: queued-hosted
idle.note: a runtime hosting the target holds queued input

idle.name: missing
idle.note: the target's record is gone when the checks run

idle.name: changed
idle.note: the target moved since the caller looked

idle.name: close-failed
idle.note: the close cannot land: another process holds the session's writer claim

idle.name: deleted
idle.note: archived, not a favorite, idle and unchanged
